mintAuthority.summary: syzUSD is Yuzu's staking wrapper of yzUSD. Plasma is the reviewed native ERC-4626 deployment, with share issuance against deposited yzUSD. Its ProxyAdmin is now owned by a 48-hour TimelockController; the previously direct 4-of-5 Safe holds proposer, executor, and canceller roles on that timelock. Satellite bridge administration remains in Bridge Risk. Parent yzUSD mint authority remains inherited through the tracked dependency.

controls.label: syzUSD ERC-4626 staking vault (share accounting)
controls.evidence: At Plasma block 33896602 on 2026-10-01, the vault resolves to verified StakedYuzuUSDV3 implementation 0x4ad9f1db810146b660eb863cc6f56649e0824a6e and asset() returns yzUSD 0x6695c0f8706c5ace3bdf8995073179cca47926dc. ERC-4626 deposits create wrapper shares against that asset rather than base yzUSD supply. V3 adds role-managed throttles and redemption settings.

controls.label: Yuzu Plasma timelock proposer/executor Safe (4-of-5)
controls.evidence: At Plasma block 33896602 on 2026-10-01, this Safe remains version 1.4.1 and 4-of-5 with the listed owners, no enabled modules, zero guard, fallback handler 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99, and the recorded master copy. It is no longer the direct ProxyAdmin owner: the owner is TimelockController 0x2130457539612ae9838e0314cda1a8abbdb7cfbc, where hasRole confirms this Safe as proposer, executor, and canceller, but not default admin. The former no-delay direct ownership observation from 2026-08-08 is historical.

controls.label: Yuzu Plasma ProxyAdmin 48-hour timelock
controls.evidence: At Plasma block 33896602, ProxyAdmin 0x7392751a860a51694231c7a0b4a9c853f8169cf0 owner() and vault defaultAdmin() both return this verified TimelockController. getMinDelay() returns 172800 seconds. The 4-of-5 Safe has proposer, executor, and canceller roles; the timelock has its own default admin role, while the probed original deployer, Safe, and zero address do not. The controller can replace mint-critical implementation logic through its scheduled execution path.

review.evidence: At Plasma block 33896602 on 2026-10-01, the canonical syzUSD vault resolves to verified StakedYuzuUSDV3 implementation 0x4ad9f1db810146b660eb863cc6f56649e0824a6e and asset() yzUSD 0x6695c0f8706c5ace3bdf8995073179cca47926dc. The immutable proxy admin remains 0x7392751a860a51694231c7a0b4a9c853f8169cf0; its owner is now TimelockController 0x2130457539612ae9838e0314cda1a8abbdb7cfbc with getMinDelay() 172800 seconds, also the vault default admin. The 4-of-5 Safe now proposes, executes, and cancels scheduled operations rather than directly owning the ProxyAdmin. Historical 2026-08-16 V2/no-delay observations are superseded by this pinned state. Wrapper shares remain backed by deposited yzUSD; satellite bridge powers stay in Bridge Risk and parent yzUSD issuance is inherited rather than duplicated.
